title: Jewelry Armor - Refined
description: Jewelry Armor - Refined is an alternative interpretation of the Jewelry Armor concept, designed for players who want to preserve their character's appearance as much as possible.
body:
![jaflr](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa79617d3be396ab2c8b310cb64077a357f35483.png)


**While Classic turns armor into jewelry, Refined pushes the idea even further. Decorative elements occupy less space on the armor, allowing the player's skin to remain the most important part of the character's appearance.
**
**The goal of Refined is simple: armor should complement the character, not hide it.**

**Features:
• Vanilla-friendly 16×16 style
• Minimal skin coverage
• Lightweight and subtle decorative details
• Focus on the character rather than the armor
• Designed for immersive gameplay and roleplay
• Preserves the original armor silhouettes**

**Refined is being developed as its own branch of Jewelry Armor and will gradually receive unique adaptations for decorative elements and armor trim patterns.**

**_Less Armor. More Character._**
_The Jewelry Armor - Refined Team_
